27	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
28	/-- **A morphism of quasi-coherent modules on `Spec R` is an isomorphism as soon as its
29	image under the global-sections functor is.** -/
30	theorem Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecΓFunctor_map {R : CommRingCat.{u}}
31	    {M N : (Spec R).Modules} [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent] (φ : M ⟶ N)
32	    (h : IsIso ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ)) : IsIso φ := by
33	  have hM : IsIso M.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent M
34	  have hN : IsIso N.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent N
35	  have key : M.fromTildeΓ ≫ φ =
36	      (tilde.functor R).map ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ) ≫ N.fromTildeΓ :=
37	    ((Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓNatTrans (R := R)).naturality φ).symm
38	  let iM := @asIso _ _ _ _ M.fromTildeΓ hM
39	  let iN := @asIso _ _ _ _ N.fromTildeΓ hN
40	  let iG := @asIso _ _ _ _ ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ) h
41	  let e : M ≅ N := iM.symm ≪≫ (tilde.functor R).mapIso iG ≪≫ iN
42	  have he : e.hom = φ :=
43	    calc e.hom
44	        = iM.inv ≫ ((tilde.functor R).map ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ)
45	            ≫ N.fromTildeΓ) := rfl
46	      _ = iM.inv ≫ (M.fromTildeΓ ≫ φ) := by rw [key]
47	      _ = φ := Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc iM φ
48	  rw [← he]
49	  exact e.isIso_hom

52	/-- Affine-target descent, section form. -/
53	theorem Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_appTop {R : CommRingCat.{u}}
54	    {M N : (Spec R).Modules} [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent] (φ : M ⟶ N)
55	    (h : Function.Bijective (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))) : IsIso φ := by
56	  refine Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecΓFunctor_map φ ?_
57	  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
58	  have hfun : ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ)) =
59	      ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))) := rfl
60	  rw [hfun]
61	  exact h

63	/-! ## §2. The mate on global sections over affine bases -/
64	
65	section MateAppTop
66	
67	variable {Y Y' X X' : Scheme.{u}}
68	
69	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
70	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
71	/-- **The base-change mate is an isomorphism on global sections over affine bases as
72	soon as the canonical `Γ`-level base-change map is bijective.**  No cartesian hypothesis,
73	no affineness of `f`. -/
74	theorem isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_appTop_of_bijective
75	    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g' : X' ⟶ X)
76	    (comm : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g) [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y']
77	    (F : X.Modules) [((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).IsQuasicoherent]
78	    (e' : f' ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)))
79	    (s : letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) :=
80	            (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : Y'.Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
81	         TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
82	             Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) →+
83	           Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F),
84	             (⊤ : Y'.Opens)))
85	    (hs : letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) :=
86	            (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : Y'.Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
87	          ∀ (b : Γ(Y', ⊤)) (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens))),
88	            s (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) =
89	              b • (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj
90	                  ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F), (⊤ : Y'.Opens)) from
91	                pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' F e' x))
92	    (hbij : Function.Bijective s) :
93	    IsIso (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
94	      (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F) (⊤ : Y'.Opens)) := by
95	  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) :=
96	    (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : Y'.Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
97	  obtain ⟨⟨eL, heL⟩⟩ := pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv g
98	    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) (isAffineOpen_top Y') (isAffineOpen_top Y)
99	    (le_top : (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens))
100	  have hcomm : ∀ w : TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
101	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)),
102	      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F)
103	        (⊤ : Y'.Opens)).hom (eL w) = s w := by
104	    intro w
105	    induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
106	    | zero => simp only [map_zero]
107	    | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add, h₁, h₂]
108	    | tmul b x =>
109	      have hb : (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x :
110	          TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
111	            Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens))) =
112	          b • ((1 : Γ(Y', ⊤)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) := by
113	        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
114	      have hsm : eL (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) =
115	          b • pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)
116	            (le_top : (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)) x := by
117	        rw [hb, _root_.map_smul, heL]
118	      rw [hsm]
119	      have hlin : (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F)
120	            (⊤ : Y'.Opens)).hom
121	            (b • pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)
122	              (le_top : (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)) x) =
123	          b • (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F)
124	            (⊤ : Y'.Opens)).hom
125	            (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)
126	              (le_top : (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)) x) :=
127	        Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul _ b _
128	      rw [hlin, pushforwardBaseChangeMap_app_baseMap f g f' g' comm F
129	        (le_top : (⊤ : Y'.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)) e' x]
130	      exact (hs b x).symm
131	  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
132	  have hfun : ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
133	      (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F) (⊤ : Y'.Opens))) =
134	      ⇑s ∘ ⇑eL.symm := by
135	    funext z
136	    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := eL.surjective z
137	    have hz : eL.symm (eL w) = w := eL.symm_apply_apply w
138	    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hz]
139	    exact hcomm w
140	  rw [hfun]
141	  exact hbij.comp (EquivLike.bijective eL.symm)
142	
143	end MateAppTop

145	/-! ## §3. The combined descent -/
146	
147	section Combined
148	
149	variable {Y X X' : Scheme.{u}} {R' : CommRingCat.{u}}
150	
151	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
152	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
153	/-- **Affine-target descent for the mate.**  If the target of `g` is `Spec R'`, the source
154	`Y` is affine, `f'` is qcqs and `F` is quasi-coherent with quasi-coherent pushforward, then
155	the base-change mate is an isomorphism as soon as the canonical `Γ`-level base-change map is
156	bijective.  **`f` is not assumed affine.** -/
157	theorem isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_of_bijective_gamma
158	    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Spec R' ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Spec R') (g' : X' ⟶ X)
159	    (comm : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g) [IsAffine Y]
160	    [QuasiCompact f'] [QuasiSeparated f']
161	    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
162	    [((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).IsQuasicoherent]
163	    (e' : f' ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec R').Opens) ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)))
164	    (s : letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Spec R', ⊤) :=
165	            (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : (Spec R').Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
166	         TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Spec R', ⊤)
167	             Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) →+
168	           Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F),
169	             (⊤ : (Spec R').Opens)))
170	    (hs : letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Spec R', ⊤) :=
171	            (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : (Spec R').Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
172	          ∀ (b : Γ(Spec R', ⊤)) (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens))),
173	            s (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) =
174	              b • (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj
175	                  ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F), (⊤ : (Spec R').Opens)) from
176	                pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' F e' x))
177	    (hbij : Function.Bijective s) :
178	    IsIso (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F) := by
179	  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
180	      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)).IsQuasicoherent :=
181	    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) inferInstance
182	  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F).IsQuasicoherent :=
183	    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom g' F inferInstance
184	  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj
185	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F)).IsQuasicoherent :=
186	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent f' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F)
187	  refine Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_appTop _ ?_
188	  have hmt := isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_appTop_of_bijective f g f' g' comm F e' s hs hbij
189	  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective] at hmt
190	  exact hmt
191	
192	end Combined

194	/-! ## §4. The gate's `baseChange` field, reduced to a `Γ`-level statement -/
195	
196	namespace Adelic
197	
198	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
199	
200	/-- **The `Γ`-level base-change leaf.**  For the constant curve `C_A`, an invertible `L`
201	with fibrewise `h¹ = 0`, and every ring map `φ : A → A'`, the canonical additive map
202	`Γ(Spec A', ⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Spec A, ⊤)} Γ(C_A, L) → Γ(C_{A'}, (g')^* L)`,
203	`b ⊗ x ↦ b · (base-map image of x)`, is bijective.  This is the module-level residue of
204	`Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange` after affine-target descent. -/
205	def RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
206	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] : Prop :=
207	  ∀ (L : (Limits.pullback C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules),
208	    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L →
209	    (∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
210	      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing L t) →
211	    ∀ (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A')
212	      (e' : (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom
213	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
214	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A')).Opens) ≤
215	        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom
216	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
217	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) ⁻¹ᵁ
218	          ((pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) ⁻¹ᵁ
219	            (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens))),
220	      letI : Algebra Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A), ⊤) Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A'), ⊤) :=
221	        ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).appLE
222	          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens)
223	          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A')).Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
224	      ∃ s : TensorProduct Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A), ⊤) Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A'), ⊤)
225	          Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd C.hom
226	              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).obj L,
227	            (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens)) →+
228	        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom
229	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
230	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))).obj
231	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom
232	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
233	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))).obj L),
234	          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A')).Opens)),
235	        (∀ b x, s (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A), ⊤)] x) =
236	          b • (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom
237	                  (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
238	                  (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))).obj
239	                ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom
240	                  (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
241	                  (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))).obj L),
242	                (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A')).Opens)) from
243	            pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap
244	              (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom
245	                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
246	                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) L e' x)) ∧
247	        Function.Bijective s
248	
249	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
250	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
251	/-- **The gate's `baseChange` field from the `Γ`-level leaf.** -/
252	theorem rigidPushforwardBaseChange_of_gamma
253	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
254	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
255	    (hgamma : RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange C A) :
256	    Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange C A := by
257	  intro L hL h1 A' _ φ
258	  haveI : IsProper (pullback.snd C.hom
259	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) :=
260	    MorphismProperty.pullback_snd (P := @IsProper) _ _ inferInstance
261	  haveI : IsProper (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom
262	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
263	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) :=
264	    MorphismProperty.pullback_snd (P := @IsProper) _ _ inferInstance
265	  haveI := hL.isFinitePresentation
266	  haveI : L.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
267	  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd C.hom
268	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).obj L).IsQuasicoherent :=
269	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent _ L
270	  have e' : (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom
271	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
272	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A')).Opens) ≤
273	      (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom
274	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
275	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) ⁻¹ᵁ
276	        ((pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) ⁻¹ᵁ
277	          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens)) := by simp
278	  obtain ⟨s, hs, hbij⟩ := hgamma L hL h1 A' φ e'
279	  exact isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_of_bijective_gamma _ _ _ _ pullback.condition L e' s hs hbij
280	
281	end Adelic

293	theorem exists_chartTensorEquiv {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
294	    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y']
295	    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] {W : X.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
296	    (hW' : IsAffineOpen (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)) :
297	    letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) := (g.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top).hom.toAlgebra
298	    letI := f.baseSectionsModule M W
299	    Nonempty { Θ : TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) Γ(M, W) ≃+
300	        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M, g' ⁻¹ᵁ W) //
301	      ∀ (b : Γ(Y', ⊤)) (x : Γ(M, W)),
302	        Θ (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) =
303	          (f'.appLE (⊤ : Y'.Opens) (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_top).hom b •
304	            pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' M (le_refl (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)) x } := sorry

307	/-- **(M2) Restriction naturality of the chart comparison.**  Generalisation of
308	`fiberChart_smul_baseMap_res`. -/
309	lemma chart_smul_baseMap_res {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X} (M : X.Modules)
310	    {W W₀ : X.Opens} {W'' : X'.Opens}
311	    (hWW₀ : W₀ ≤ W) (hW'' : W'' ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ W₀) (hle : W'' ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
312	    (b : Γ(Y', ⊤)) (x : Γ(M, W)) :
313	    (((((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom
314	        ((f'.appLE (⊤ : Y'.Opens) (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_top).hom b •
315	          pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' M (le_refl (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)) x)) :
316	        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M, W'')) =
317	      (f'.appLE (⊤ : Y'.Opens) W'' le_top).hom b •
318	        pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' M hW''
319	          ((M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW₀).op).hom x) := sorry

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RigidPushforwardP1Constants
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RigidPushforwardTransfer

/-!
# The `HasRigidPushforward` gate, factored into its exact remaining leaves

`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean` declares the campaign gate
`Scheme.HasRigidPushforward C` (:373) with two fields, `locallyFree` and
`baseChange`, and no instance anywhere in the tree.  The purpose of this file
is to make the *shape* of the discharge exact: to say, as machine-checked Lean
rather than prose, precisely which statements remain and how they compose into
the gate.

## The factorization

For an AJC curve — `C : Over (Spec k)` with
`[SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]`
— the gate is *equivalent* to four named statements, three of which concern
only `ℙ¹`:

1. **`IsIntegral (ℙ¹_k)`** (`Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Constants.lean` §5):
   integrality of the projective line over the one field `k`.  This is the
   cheapest sufficient form of the `H⁰`-finiteness anchor.
   `GeometricallyIntegral (p1Over k).hom` is strictly stronger and implies it;
   `Γ(ℙ¹_k, 𝒪) = k` (`P1HasTrivialConstants k`, §3 there) is *incomparable*
   with it but also discharges the anchor, through
   `p1RigidPushforwardStatement_of_leaves`.
2. **`P1CechFibrewiseBridge k A`** (§1 here): fibrewise `Ȟ¹`-vanishing of `M`
   on `ℙ¹_A` at all scheme points forces the base-linear Čech differential to
   stay surjective after `⊗ κ(𝔪)` at maximal ideals.  This is the geometric
   half of Mumford's "vanishing on the closed fibres" hypothesis, in the
   spelling the algebraic engine consumes.
3. **`P1PushforwardLocalFreenessBridge k A`** (§2 here): the *output* bridge —
   the engine's module-level conclusion (`d` surjective, `H⁰ = ker d` finite
   projective, `H⁰` commuting with arbitrary base change) upgraded to the
   sheaf-level conclusion that `p_* M` is locally free of pointwise rank
   `p.fiberH0 M t`.
4. **`Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange C A`** — the second gate field, for
   which the tree currently has *no* infrastructure at all (see the caveat
   below).  These four are named leaves, not equal-sized ones: leaf 4 is one
   of the gate's two fields and is plausibly larger than leaves 1–3 combined.

§3 assembles 1–3 into `P1RigidPushforwardStatement k A`, the sole hypothesis
of `rigidPushforwardLocallyFree_of_p1Engine`
(`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`:1391), hence into the gate's
`locallyFree` field; §4 assembles everything into `HasRigidPushforward C`.
Note that `HasFiniteMapToP1 C`, which the transfer package needs, is **not** a
leaf: it synthesizes for an AJC curve through
`hasFiniteMapToP1_of_existsNonconstantMapToP1` ∘
`existsNonconstantMapToP1_of_existsNonconstantMapToProjInt` ∘
`existsNonconstantMapToProjInt_of_ajc`
(`RiemannRoch/Adelic/{FiniteMapToP1,NonconstantToP1}.lean`), all sorry-free.

## Caveat on the `baseChange` field (recorded, not hidden)

`Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange` asks for `IsIso` of the adjoint mate
`pushforwardBaseChangeMap` for the **proper** family `q : C_A ⟶ Spec A` and
*arbitrary* ring maps `A → A'`.  The tree's only `IsIso` theorems for that
mate (`isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_of_isPullback`,
`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`:1108, and its chart form :949) require
`[IsAffineHom f]`, and with `IsAffineHom q` assumed the field closes in one
line — so the entire content of the field is the non-affine case.  There is
also no composition/pasting API for `pushforwardBaseChangeMap` in the tree, so
the natural "reduce along the finite `π_A`, then treat `p : ℙ¹_A ⟶ Spec A`"
strategy cannot yet be assembled even once the second half exists.  The
module-level input is available (`kerBaseChange` bijective for *every*
`Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`-algebra, the fourth conclusion of
`p1Cech_h0_baseChange_of_fibrewise_h1_vanishing`); the sheaf-level bridge is
not.  This is deliberately left as the fourth leaf rather than papered over.

Sources: Mumford, *Abelian Varieties*, II §5; EGA III 7.9.9; Hartshorne III
12.11; Kleiman, *The Picard scheme* (FGA Explained), §5; Stacks 02KG.
-/

/-!
# The `HasRigidPushforward` frontier after the fibre-chart and sheaf bricks

`Picard/RigidPushforwardGate.lean` factored the B3 campaign gate into four
named leaves.  Two of them have since been discharged, and this file records
the resulting state of the frontier — as Lean, not as prose.

## What is now closed

* **Leaf 2, `P1CechFibrewiseBridge k A`, is PROVED**
  (`p1CechFibrewiseBridge_proved` below, from
  `Adelic.p1_hfib_of_fiberH1Vanishing`,
  `Picard/RigidPushforwardFiberChart.lean`).  Fibrewise Čech
  `h¹`-vanishing of a finitely presented `M` on `ℙ¹_A` at every scheme point
  really does force the base-linear Čech differential to stay surjective
  after `⊗ κ(𝔪)` at every maximal ideal.  The proof runs Stacks 02KG in
  degree `0` on each affine chart of `ℙ¹_A` — the section-ring pushout on
  arbitrary compatible affine opens (`isPushout_appLE_of_isPullback'`,
  generalising the `f ⁻¹ᵁ V`-pinned form, which is unusable here because
  `p ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ = ℙ¹_A` is not affine), the resulting chart comparison
  `κ(t) ⊗_{Γ(Spec A, ⊤)} Γ(M, W) ≅ Γ(M_t, W_t)` and its restriction
  naturality, the intertwining with the Čech differential, and the
  maximal-ideal-to-point package.

* **Leaf 3's sheaf half is PROVED**
  (`Adelic.p1PushforwardLocalFreenessBridge_of_rank`,
  `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Sheaf.lean`): a quasi-coherent module on
  `Spec R` whose global sections are finite projective *is* free of rank
  `rankAtStalk` on a basic-open neighbourhood of any point
  (`exists_free_restrict_of_finite_projective_sections`), and
  `Γ(Spec A, p_* M)` really is `ker d`
  (`Adelic.pushforwardTop_linearEquiv_ker`).

## What remains — the whole frontier, in two statements plus one field

`p1RigidPushforwardStatement_of_isIntegral_of_rank` below shows that the ℙ¹
engine statement, hence the gate's `locallyFree` field, now needs exactly:

1. **`IsIntegral (ℙ¹_k)`** — integrality of the projective line over the one
   field `k`.  The load-bearing sub-probe is the chart-ring identification
   `Γ(ℙ¹, D₊(X₀)) ≅ R[T]`: the tree has the spanning half
   (`span_p1CoordAway_pow_top`, `RiemannRoch/Adelic/P1ChartData.lean`) and
   nothing about freeness, and `RelLaurentChartData` supplies spanning but
   never a basis.  mathlib has `GeometricallyIrreducible`/`Reduced`/`Integral`
   for *affine* space and no integrality API for `Proj` at all, so landing
   the chart iso would give `IsReduced` and `IrreducibleSpace` of `ℙ¹` by
   transport.

2. **`P1RankIdentity k A`** — that the pointwise rank of `p_* M` really is
   the fibre `h⁰`, `sectionsRankAtStalk (p_* M) t = p.fiberH0 M t`, *for `M`
   satisfying the engine's own conclusions* (`d` surjective, `H⁰ = ker d`
   finite projective, `H⁰` base-change compatible).  Those hypotheses are
   load-bearing, not decoration: dropped, the statement is FALSE — take
   `A = k[x]` and `M = 𝒪/x`, where `Γ(ℙ¹_A, M) = k` is torsion so the stalk
   rank is the junk value `0`, while the fibre is `ℙ¹_k` with `M_t = 𝒪` and
   `fiberH0 M t = 1`.  Projectivity is exactly what excludes it.  With them,
   this is the same fibre-chart base change leaf 2 already uses: the chart
   comparison `exists_fiberChartTensorEquiv` identifies `ker (d ⊗ κ(t))` with
   the Čech `H⁰` of the fibre, i.e. with `Γ(ℙ¹_t, M_t)`, and
   `Module.rankAtStalk_eq` plus the engine's `kerBaseChange` bijectivity at
   `B = κ(t)` convert that into the rank statement.  So this is assembly of
   bricks that now exist, not new mathematics.

and, for the gate's second field,

3. **`Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange C A`** — untouched, and the largest
   of the three: it is one of the gate's two fields and plausibly exceeds
   items 1 and 2 combined.  Every `IsIso`
   theorem for the adjoint mate `pushforwardBaseChangeMap` in this tree
   requires `[IsAffineHom f]`, and `q : C_A ⟶ Spec A` is proper; with
   `IsAffineHom q` assumed the field closes in one line, so its entire
   content is the non-affine case.  There is also no composition/pasting API
   for `pushforwardBaseChangeMap`, so "reduce along the finite affine `π_A`,
   then treat `p : ℙ¹_A ⟶ Spec A`" cannot yet be assembled.

Sources: Mumford, *Abelian Varieties*, II §5; Stacks 02KG, 01YS; EGA III
7.9.9; Kleiman, *The Picard scheme* (FGA Explained), §5.
-/

def RigidPushforwardBaseChange (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] : Prop :=
  ∀ L : (Limits.pullback C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules,
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L →
    (∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing L t) →
    ∀ (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A'),
      IsIso (pushforwardBaseChangeMap
        (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
        pullback.condition L)
